tasks.short: Compute assistance amounts and authorize grants or payments.

steps.what: Compute assistance amounts from the published table
Authorize grants, payments, or food stamps
Sign the authorized amount for this version

outputs: filed copy of signed assistance amount v1

tasks.design: A job computes the amount from the published table and the figures the interviewer entered in {GOV_PORTAL}. The interviewer authorizes grants, payments, or food stamps, signs that amount, and a job files it. The arithmetic is not a score, and it is not the decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Amounts were worked by hand, and a worksheet could become a number nobody had authorized.
tasks.enabler_now: A published table can be applied with plain code.
tasks.still_hard: Whether this person qualifies is not in the table.
tasks.human_edge: The interviewer authorizes the amount and remains responsible for it.

ambition.what: Recompute the table amount when the published table changes, and authorize it again.

tasks.altitude: The interviewer spends the case on the authorization, not on the arithmetic.

evidence.claim: The clerk digest says benefit computations are plain code, while eligibility judgement stays with a person.
Digest [S11] bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, so the interviewer authorizes every grant, denial, change, or amount.
Digest [S13] says a score a decision-maker draws strongly on counts as the decision, so this design uses a published table and does not produce a score.
Digest [S15] lists benefit eligibility as a high-risk use, and digest [S16] places those duties from 2 December 2027, so eligibility status stays with the interviewer.

assumptions: The job never authorizes an amount.
Configure the case record before a new store.
unknowns: Which published table applies to this program.
Who else must sign above a set amount.
research_questions: How often the entered figures are incomplete.

already_counted.description: Authorizing the amount stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Update the published table or the required-field list when the rule changes, and clear cases the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only a completeness check or filing moves to a job. The interview, the decision, and the signature stay with the interviewer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep records of assigned cases and prepare required reports.

steps.what: Prepare required reports from those case records
Review the required report before it leaves

outputs: filed copy of signed case report v1

tasks.design: The interviewer keeps the case record in {GOV_PORTAL}. A dashboard prepares the required report from those records only. The interviewer reviews it, signs it, and a job publishes that version. A row with no case id is dropped.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were copied out of the case file and could drift from it.
tasks.enabler_now: The case record can feed a report without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: What the report should say about a case is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The interviewer decides the report is fit to send.

ambition.what: Refresh the case report when the period closes, and publish only a newly signed version.

tasks.altitude: The interviewer spends reporting time on the review, not on copying rows.

evidence.claim: The clerk digest says benefit computations are plain code, while eligibility judgement stays with a person.
Digest [S11] bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, so the interviewer authorizes every grant, denial, change, or amount.

assumptions: The report cites case records and does not add a score.
Configure the case record before a new store.
unknowns: Which report is required, and by whom.
Whether a report may name a person.
research_questions: How often case records are late for the report date.

already_counted.description: Keeping and reviewing the case record stays inside the remaining time of those steps.

incremental.description: Update the published table or the required-field list when the rule changes, and clear cases the job cannot file.

tasks.short: Compile financial data, check completeness, and determine eligibility.

steps.what: Compile and record personal and financial data
Verify completeness against the required field list
Evaluate accuracy and determine eligibility status

outputs: filed copy of signed eligibility status v1

tasks.design: The interviewer compiles and records the personal and financial data in {GOV_PORTAL}. A job flags blank required fields and does nothing else. The interviewer evaluates accuracy and determines eligibility status, signs it, and a job files that version. There is no score.
tasks.previous_blocker: Completeness and the status decision were one untraced reading of the file.
tasks.enabler_now: Required fields can be listed and checked.
tasks.still_hard: Accuracy and status still depend on the interviewer.
tasks.human_edge: The interviewer determines eligibility status and is responsible for it.
tasks.altitude: The status decision does not shrink. Flagging blank fields and filing the signed status do.

reach.task: Supply a missing field the interviewer named
reach.learn: That a blank-field list is not a decision

evidence.claim: Digest [S15] lists benefit eligibility as a high-risk use, and digest [S16] places those duties from 2 December 2027, so eligibility status stays with the interviewer.
Digest [S11] bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, so the interviewer authorizes every grant, denial, change, or amount.
Digest [S13] says a score a decision-maker draws strongly on counts as the decision, so this design uses a published table and does not produce a score.
Digest [S10] records that a welfare-fraud model flagged more people, was no better than caseworkers, and was stopped, so no such model is built and the person decides.

assumptions: The field check does not infer a status.
No ranking of applicants is stored.
unknowns: Which fields are required for this program.
Who else must sign a denial.
research_questions: How often documents contradict the form.

already_counted.description: Determining status stays inside the remaining time of that step.

tasks.short: Interview and investigate applicants for public assistance.

steps.what: Investigate applications and gather pertinent information

outputs: filed copy of signed interview note v1

tasks.design: The interview and the investigation stay with the interviewer, in person or by phone. A job files the note in {GOV_PORTAL} only after the interviewer signs it. The interview is not recorded into a dashboard, and emotion is not scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notes were uneven, and a recording could have become a staff dashboard.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed note can be filed in the case record.
tasks.still_hard: What is pertinent still depends on the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The interviewer decides what was learned and what is still missing.
tasks.altitude: Interview time does not shrink. Filing the signed note does.

reach.task: Bring the document the signed note names
reach.learn: That the note is not a decision

evidence.claim: Digest [S20] prohibits emotion recognition, so an interview is not scored for how a person sounds or looks.
Digest [S21] says call recording and staff dashboards need works-council consent, so interviews are not recorded into a dashboard.
Digest [S10] records that a welfare-fraud model flagged more people, was no better than caseworkers, and was stopped, so no such model is built and the person decides.

assumptions: No recording and no emotion score.
The note is the interviewer's words.
unknowns: Whether local rules treat the note as a formal statement.
research_questions: How often a second interview is required.

already_counted.description: The interview and the investigation stay inside the remaining time of those steps.

role.altitude: The eligibility interviewer spends the week on the interview and the decision. Completeness checks and filing a signed note move to a job. No model decides a benefit or scores a person.
reach: Applicants hear the decision from the interviewer, not from a generated refusal.
Social workers receive only the extract the interviewer signed.
skills_to_grow: Tell a published table amount from the decision to authorize it.
Refuse any list that ranks or flags people.
role.ambitious_version: A signed decision can open the payment instruction, and the interviewer still authorizes that amount.
